title: I am creating my dream desktop companion game.
author: OtonPaiva
selftext:
I aways liked the desktop companion genre, and also monster collection like pokemon and digimon, so I decided to create my own universe, mashing these two together. So for the past year or so I've been developing this game and after many iterations I finally am able to show my work.

The idea is an online desktop companion, where you can add your friends, do pvp, trade, chat, and use your pets on an autobattler system, to farm equipment and materials, so you can summon more pets for your collection!



I am currently opening the playtest if anyone has any interest, so I can iron out as much bugs as possible before launch, and also stress test the game and server.

https://reddit.com/link/1xnuyp9/video/dvc4tr3lwmzh1/player
